ablation.s0_ivw_definition: dataset-level constant: naive RMS of AqSolDB aqsol_sd (report-spread metadata) over all multi-report compounds, computed once and identical for every split/seed; no test-compound logS labels are used (their SD metadata enters this one scalar)
